title: Goat's Cheese Tart 2
preamble:
Based On Hairy Bikers
Ingredients:-
50g
butter
2
red onions, thinly sliced
25g
light brown sugar
2
tablespoons red wine vinegar
150g
goat's cheese
1
sprig thyme leaves chopped
1
parsley to garnish

50g
butter
2
red onions, thinly sliced
25g
light brown sugar
2
tablespoons red wine vinegar

150g
goat's cheese
1
sprig thyme leaves chopped

1
parsley to garnish

Method:-
Melt the butter and gently fry onions and sugar for 30 minutes until well softened
Add the vinegar and thyme and simmer for another 5 minutes until the liquid has almost gone
Leave to cool
Pre-heat the oven to Gas Mark 7
Unroll the puff pastry, roll thinner if need be
Cut into 4inch rectangles
Place on baking sheet and prick with a fork
Bake for 10 minutes then remove from oven and flatten with a spatula
Put onion mixture on pastry
Put cheese slice on top
Season with black pepper
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes until pastry is golden brown and the cheese is melting
